instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium close-up at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. On a warm outdoor patio, the woman in the grey long-sleeve shirt (R1) on the left smiles warmly with closed eyes, facing the young woman in the floral dress (R2) on the right. The young woman (R2) faces left, smiling softly with her gaze cast downward. The woman (R1) maintains a close embrace, keeping her right hand placed gently on the young woman's (R2) shoulder. The lighting is warm and natural, casting soft shadows and enhancing the tender, emotional mood.

R1 maintains the close embrace with R2
